Overview.Name: Jayasree
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + curd + paneer curry ( ~ 120 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (2 cups, low salt)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + egg curry (1–2 eggs)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Thick curd bowl + boiled vegetables (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice controlled and always eat egg or paneer first for better sugar control.
Avoid very spicy and high salt food to manage BP.
Limit outside food during social gatherings. Eat protein first.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch for better sugar and joint management.
Gradual weight loss will reduce joint stress and improve energy in 8–12 weeks.
